partition: three contiguous ordered chunks, [0,160), [160,320), [320,480); one process gets [0,480)
timing: Parent start immediately before launching workers through child completion, private JSON/CSV consumption and merged issue CSV generation. Guard checks are outside timing. Includes interpreter/import startup, model parse, processing, worker output and parent merge.
initialization: Ready offsets share the Windows system-wide performance-counter clock. Imports/setup is entry-to-ready; startup-to-ready includes interpreter launch. Parse is the existing consumer parse timer. Per-worker setup runs once per partition.
parallelism: Three independent fresh Python subprocesses, each constructing its own model and fragment cache. Pass config/range only; no parsed-model pickling, shared mutable state, fork assumption, affinity pinning or production API change.
CPU: Sum of worker API/report process_time deltas; excludes worker startup/import CPU and parent CPU. Not total process-lifetime CPU.
memory: Sum of worker peak working sets, including imports; an upper bound/budget, not a synchronized measurement of concurrent RAM. Parent excluded.
guard: Exact frozen source hashes, seven control/database hashes and 50 input-file metadata records before/after every native trial; complete public-run parity before timing; exact ordered global index coverage and all 50 physical path identities after combining native workers.
parity: Independently parsed deterministic UUIDs; complete partition records equal the saved 480-run single-process records after restoring requested global run indices. No path sets/counts substitute for full provenance. Normal UUIDs in timed trials.
limitations: Only one and three processes measured; no optimum among 2/4/6/8 established.
SSD warm/unspecified caches; no three-process SMB timing.
CPU clocks/load drift: use the fresh matched one-process baseline, not the earlier 18-second session.
Two ABBA blocks; descriptive workload-specific scaling, not a universal speedup.
Partial-prefix initialization measurements are single observations, not performance acceptance runs.
Cache work, repeated initialization, all-core clock/cache effects and merge overhead are not causally isolated.
privacy: Public numeric aggregates and audit code only; raw models, flags, paths, manifests, full records and CSVs remain private.
audits: Worker source is preserved with canonical text line endings/EOF; controller additionally changes only private-root routing to environment variables.
